g.text: A21 | Fzd4 enrichment recurs in an independent capillary dataset
GSE211335: 12 animals, 3 per condition. Pairs require >=20 cells per state; lines join states within the same animal.
Seven pairs qualify. RNA enrichment does not establish renewal, receptor engagement or vascular function.
